items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Now where Danny Barker was playing, there's a trombone player there. He sounded pretty good in his German fellow. He sounded nice.

ctx.x: Now I want you to understand me. I never knock another musician. I mean it doesn't do you any good. It hurts you, not the musician. Then you make an enemy for life. Now I've heard Louie Nelson, I've heard this other Jim Robinson, and I've heard some trombone players here. Now where Danny Barker was playing, there's a trombone player there. He sounded pretty good in his German fellow. He sounded nice. And I'm not fine with Jim Robinson, nobody. They're friends of mine. All I'm saying is that I had to get away from…
No. But it's low instrument, right?
